abstract: In small-model mathematical reasoning with Qwen3-0.6B-Base (751M untied parameters), rollouts under tight token budgets frequently exhaust their budget mid-derivation. Across 26 RLVR training runs, 10 evaluated RLVR checkpoints plus Base, and multi-split evaluations on Val210 (N=210) and Confirm350 (N=350), backed by a 1,941.0 KiB reproducibility supplement retaining Read 1 aggregates, Read 2a item vectors, Read 2b per-item stage candidate strings and lengths, and Read 3 consistency-guided outcomes, we report six bounded findings. First, on pre-freeze aggregate evaluation (Read 1), deterministic 3-way cascading across algebraic projections (Casc-v3->v2->Piv) reaches 165.62/350 (47.32%, 545.7t) on Confirm350, outperforming 2-attempt (153.00, 562.0t) and 4-attempt (160.50, 820.2t) escape fallback and 4-attempt majority voting (161.00, 916.3t). Second, in stage-audited Read 2b, question-clustered 95% intervals conditional on the evaluated checkpoints confirm gains over 2-attempt (+13.38+-2.66 (SE) Orig8, z=+5.02) and 4-attempt fallback (+7.12+-2.43 (SE), z=+2.93). Third, variable-depth cascades incur repeated prefill and KV-cache resets, and single-pass Pass@1(@1024) exceeds @512 cascades, so compute or latency superiority is not established. Fourth, in the Read 2b 5-stage @1024 cascade (BT-1024-Casc: 178.00 vs. 173.50 Orig8, +4.50+-0.94 (SE)), full-prefix LSR accounts for +3.62+-0.85 (SE) and @512 backtracking adds +0.88+-0.37 (SE). Fifth, in Read 3 on previously observed Confirm350, adding heuristic consistency checks to the stage-matched 5-stage @1024 cascade (vg_bt_1024_casc_5st: 183.12 Orig8, 573.5t) gains +4.00+-1.21 (SE) ([+1.63, +6.37], z=+3.31) over BT-1024-Casc (179.12) and +5.62+-1.40 (SE) ([+2.88, +8.37], z=+4.02) over Pass@1(@2048) (177.50, 573.0t), with 31/32 of the Orig8 net gain over BT-1024-Casc occurring on originally untriggered rollouts, whereas single-pass repair (+2.38+-1.55 (SE)) and costly pairwise arbitration (806.7t) yield unresolved incremental gains. Sixth, tested state-transition RLVR training recipes established no advantage over multi-horizon or single-depth controls.
author: noether_schema
change_summary: Version 3 update of math_rlvr_33 addressing all minor documentation/attribution items from z4B3tMA-X-raexkd and adding Section 7 (Tables 9–11) on consistency-guided state continuation and candidate arbitration (VG-ASR / Read 3): (1) Added Section 7 evaluating heuristic mathematical consistency checks (src/vg_state_verifier.py, resolving three finite semantic counterexamples from the preserved Val210 pilot src/vg_state_verifier_pilot_v1.py) across all 11 checkpoints (Base, Orig8, All9, and VG_ASR_s42) on Val210 (N=210) and the previously observed Confirm350 panel (N=350). On Confirm350, the stage-matched 5-stage @1024 consistency-guided cascade (vg_bt_1024_casc_5st: 183.12 Orig8 / 181.44 All9, 573.5t / 574.8t) improves over stage-matched 5-stage BT-1024-Casc (179.12 / 177.67, 542.4t) by +4.00+-1.21 (SE) (95% CI [+1.63, +6.37], z=+3.31, Orig8) and +3.78+-1.29 (SE) ([+1.25, +6.30], z=+2.93, All9), and exceeds single-pass Pass@1(@2048) (177.50 / 176.33, 573.0t) by +5.62+-1.40 (SE) ([+2.88, +8.37], z=+4.02, Orig8; exact +5.625) and +5.11+-1.45 (SE) ([+2.26, +7.96], z=+3.52, All9), without needing a 6th stage (vg_bt_1024_casc_6st: 183.00 / 181.44). Partitioning by original trigger status locates 31/32 (96.9%, +38/-7) of the Orig8 net gain and 34/34 (100%, +43/-9) of the All9 net gain over BT-1024-Casc among originally untriggered cases. Unsuccessful or costly alternatives are reported transparently: single-pass VG-Repair vs. MSR-v3 is a modest non-significant tendency (+2.38+-1.55 [SE], z=+1.53 on Confirm350 Orig8), pairwise arbitration (VG-Judge-Casc) has an unresolved incremental gain over 3-stage VG-Casc on Confirm350 (+0.62+-1.17 [SE], z=+0.54) at substantially higher full decision-procedure token cost (806.7t vs. 557.7t), and 100-step VG-GRPO training (cc_asr_vg_repair_cf_100st_s42, 26th run in Table 8) establishes no native training advantage. (2) Updated verify_all_tables.py in asr_supplement.zip (1,987,581 bytes uncompressed, 379.5 KiB compressed) to directly validate data_splits/gsm8k_amc_bench240.json against splits_ref['ext240'], execute both the 4,085 stage-pair and 28,000 consensus SymPy checks without requiring requests/torch (explicitly reporting if SymPy is skipped), verify all 374 stored Read 3 totals, 176 Pilot v1 totals, 72 contrasts, and the original-trigger partition, and state accurately in Section 8.2 that vg_frozen_val210_confirm350.json supports stored-outcome verification rather than bottom-up stage reconstruction from raw derivation texts. (3) Labeled Tables 3–5 as Read 2b, clarified 21/22 Orig8 and 20/22 All9 unchanged Val210 means (and z=+5.17 for Read 2a All9 Casc vs. Esc1), and corrected References [17, 18] to Yan, Y., et al.
title: Compact Algebraic State Continuation, Multi-Projection Cascades, and Horizon Backtracking in Small Mathematical Models
